thesis: The episode introduces Kip McDaniel, the chief content officer and editorial director at Institutional Investor, who previously served as the founding editor of CIO magazine. McDaniel discusses his background as a journalist and elite crew rower, detailing how he began covering the industry in 2004 by writing an article predicting the departure of high-paid bond managers from the Harvard Endowment.
